units.translation: Of the future ἔσομαι [I will be], the second person ἔσει [you will be] is consistently written ἔσῃ [you will be] at Sept. 68, Ag. 1410, 1633, Ch. 484, Suppl. 460. ἔσται [he/she/it will be] at Pr. 189, 623, 908, Ag. 1179, 1249, Eum. 550, 854, 865. [Infinitive ἔσεσθαι [to be going to be] at Pr. 835.]
